results.note: Comparison flip == -> >=; a store with a newer schema than this tool now silently returns instead of raising StoreVersionError.
Comparison flip > -> <; the newer-schema guard now fires for an older schema and lets a genuinely newer schema fall through into the migration loop.
Off-by-one: drops the +1, so the migration for the already-applied current version is re-run.
Reversed iteration dropped when dropping derived tables before rebuild; can violate FK ordering during teardown.
INSERT OR IGNORE -> INSERT OR REPLACE; a re-seen source row is now clobbered (losing first_seen) instead of left alone.
Dropped normalization: canonical_name no longer lowercases, so case-differing symbols are treated as distinct commodities.
Swapped/dropped table of flag names: 'Rare' commodities silently lose their flag.
Guard-clause negation dropped: project_one now bails out early for valid market kinds and proceeds (incorrectly) for invalid ones.
Guard clause removed: a snapshot with no market_id is no longer rejected and gets written with a null market_id.
Comparison flip == -> !=; deletes every other observation's market items instead of the stale rows for this obs_id.
Comparison flip != -> ==; the first-run config write now fires only for the store verb instead of for every verb except it.
Operator swap or -> and; when args.store_command is None/falsy, verb becomes None instead of defaulting to "verify".
The missing-store message is dropped (the generator's is_file negation is not unique in cli.py; this is the same site's observable effect).
Comparison flip == -> !=; the missing-store exit code is now 0 for every verb except verify, inverted from intent.
